0022600146.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (4-0, on a four-game win streak) visit the Portland Trail Blazers (3-0) for Memphis's fifth game of the season, with Memphis 3-0 on the road and 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back. Portland is out Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, listed as surgery). The Grizzlies lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, and their last meeting was a 122-114 loss in Memphis on March 4, with no games yet between the teams in 2026-27.
